# PicoRV32

`picorv32.v` is the PicoRV32 RISC-V core by Claire Xenia Wolf, taken
unmodified from <https://github.com/YosysHQ/picorv32> at commit
`ef203c2b0a3fb793280f5114941416c425c5b461`. It is distributed under the ISC
license in `COPYING`.

This project uses the `picorv32` core (RV32IM, PCPI enabled) and the
`picorv32_axi_adapter` module from this file.
